# Array-valued statement results survive semicolons and trailing declarations.
len({ [4, 5]; }) => 2
fn weights(){ [4, 5]; }; sum(weights()) => 9
{ [9]; fn local(){1}; }[0] => 9
sum(if 0 { 1 / 0 } else { [6]; let marker=push([9], 0); }) => 6
sum({ while 1 { [3]; break; }; }) => 3
0 && { [5]; let marker=push([0], 1); 1 / 0 } => 0
fn twice(n){n*2}; sum({ map([2, 3], twice); let marker=push([9], 0); }) => 10
let data=[7,8]; sum({ data; let ignored={ data=[1]; 0 }; }) + data[0] => 16
let scratch=[1]; sum({ [7,8]; let ignored={ scratch=9; 0 }; }) => 15
sum({ [2,3]; let inner=sum({ [7,8]; let marker=push([9], 0); }); }) => 5
{ [9]; let marker=push([0], 1); }[1] => error:array index out of bounds
[1]; let marker=0; => error:expected integer
{ [1]; let marker=1 / 0; }[0] => error:division by zero
